issues.description: The concept of the second returned measurement-list from build_msd_circ is referred to inconsistently: the problem statement and the solution describe/return the measurements of the 15 tetrahedral code qubits (destructive X-basis measurements of the code qubits), whereas the template's docstring describes the second return value as the "final X-basis measurements of the distilled state" (which suggests measuring the distilled_state qubit). This naming mismatch can mislead students about which qubits are being measured and which measurement indices the function should return.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template docstring use the same terminology as the problem statement and solution. For example: "Return a tuple (teleport_measurements, code_qubit_measurements), where the second list contains the destructive X-basis measurements of the 15 tetrahedral code qubits (in the same order as the qubits)." Alternatively, rename the returned variable in template to code_measurements or tetrahedral_measurements to match the problem and solution.
